g.text: SERVO BUS: half-duplex buffers, leg ports

g.desc: SERVO BUS: half-duplex buffers, leg ports

g.text: 1. Fused in and out: F1 7 A in; F2/F3 4 A servo ports; F4/F5 3 A wheel drivers; F6 1 A buck;

g.desc: 1. Fused in and out: F1 7 A in; F2/F3 4 A servo ports; F4/F5 3 A wheel drivers; F6 1 A buck;

g.text: F7/F8 0.1 A encoder supplies; F9 0.1 A 3V3 to P&D; F10 0.5 A USB VBUS.

g.desc: F7/F8 0.1 A encoder supplies; F9 0.1 A 3V3 to P&D; F10 0.5 A USB VBUS.

g.text: 2. DRV8874 ITRIP 1.80 A in hardware (VREF 3V3, RIPROPI 4.02k); firmware limit can stay as a second layer.

g.desc: 2. DRV8874 ITRIP 1.80 A in hardware (VREF 3V3, RIPROPI 4.02k); firmware limit can stay as a second layer.

g.text: 3. ESP32-S3 GPIO: see README pin map. Servo bus: UART1 half-duplex, SERVO_nTXEN = RTS (inverted).

g.desc: 3. ESP32-S3 GPIO: see README pin map. Servo bus: UART1 half-duplex, SERVO_nTXEN = RTS (inverted).

g.text: 4. One GND plane (In1). PCB antenna at the board edge with copper keep-out on all layers.

g.desc: 4. One GND plane (In1). PCB antenna at the board edge with copper keep-out on all layers.
